title: An empty hour answer bricks setup permanently, with a stack trace
method: seeded the shared progress file with the value the window wizard stores, then ran setup
triggers: morning="" in ~/.cura/setup-progress.json (cleared hour box in the window wizard)
observed_at_discovery: `cura setup` died with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'group' at wizard.py:144 in to_hour24. No config was written and 'completed' was never set, so `cura rehearse` and `cura add-phone` both refuse. Every subsequent run fails identically -- `ask` returns the stored empty string without re-asking -- so the only escape is deleting a file he has never been told about. gui.go_next stores "" for morning/evening because neither is `required` and the check only runs on non-empty values; both wizards share the file.
